GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   C. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   B. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   D. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   D. Treat Fishing as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   B. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   D. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   D. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   C. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

16. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   C. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Underground Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Karst Scenery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Settlement and urbanisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
